items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: So we'd play, had cooperators around the corner, Sam Morgan.

ctx.x: No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. He had the power, so you just don't go on down there and just write.
Well, I went back to the band. Joe was in the band. So we'd play, had cooperators around the corner, Sam Morgan.
